$comment: The global header and footer, on every public page (src/components/GlobalHeader.astro, GlobalFooter.astro, through src/layouts/Site.astro). Tasks in the main nav, audiences in the utility links and the footer, one button (Join The Labs), as design/information-architecture (the project doc) sets out. An href starting with / is a page here; anything else is a key into home.json's links (the live site). Until the owner pages exist (Workshops, Build Cycles, Find a Lab, About are built in later PRs), the main links go to the best place there is today: the live site's pages, or the home page's scenes.

footer.lede: Free workshops and team projects at your local public library, made by volunteers and open to anyone.
